entities.name: Query IspD/IspF
observations: 403 aa bacterial protein; predicted molecular weight 43.39 kDa and pI 5.22.
Pfam domains: IspD (PF01128) at residues 4-228 and YgbB (PF02542) at residues 241-396, with NTP_transf_3 (PF12804) overlap at residues 5-128.
Closest curated Swiss-Prot homologs are bifunctional IspD/IspF proteins with 45.2-46.4% identity and 97.8-99.0% query coverage.
Likely catalyzes both MEP cytidylyltransferase and ME-cPP synthase reactions; exact assignment is homology-based rather than direct experimental evidence for this sequence.
Likely requires a divalent metal cation, based on curated homolog annotations.
Associated with the methylerythritol phosphate pathway for isopentenyl diphosphate and terpenoid biosynthesis.

entities.name: MEP pathway
observations: The methylerythritol phosphate pathway produces isopentenyl diphosphate through the non-mevalonate route and supports terpenoid biosynthesis.
IspD activity corresponds to step 2 of the pathway; IspF activity corresponds to step 4.

entities.name: MEP cytidylyltransferase reaction
observations: 2-C-methyl-D-erythritol 4-phosphate plus CTP yields 4-CDP-2-C-methyl-D-erythritol plus diphosphate; Rhea RHEA:13429.
This reaction is assigned to IspD homologs and is inferred for the query protein from strong sequence homology.

entities.name: ME-cPP synthase reaction
observations: 4-CDP-2-C-methyl-D-erythritol 2-phosphate yields 2-C-methyl-D-erythritol 2,4-cyclic diphosphate plus CMP; Rhea RHEA:23864.
This reaction is assigned to IspF homologs and is inferred for the query protein from strong sequence homology.
